name: USGS Pikes Peak, 1:125,000, edition of 1901 (reprinted 1909)
basis: Cut from the USGS scan (Pikes_Peak_402404_1901_62500.tif), placed by the sheet's four corner marks because the file's own georeference is wrong, with the NAD27 shift applied. Until 24 Nov 2026 this overlay was cut by the file's georeference and showed the wrong ground.

name: Aerial photograph, 29 October 1953 (Army Map Service, frame 133-2193)
basis: Fitted by hand to the racetrack and railway. 30 to 40 m in the town, worse on the hills
notes: Four years after the railway closed. Coarse (4 m per pixel), but it shows water still standing in the lake bed below the Monte Carlo, and the highway newly laid on the old grade.

name: Aerial photograph, 17 September 1962 (USGS, frame FR-18-19)
basis: Fitted by hand to the racetrack and railway. about 15 m near the racetrack and railway, worse on the hills
notes: Three years before the flood. Shows the airstrip, the last buildings by the highway bend, the drained lake bed below the Monte Carlo, and the reservoirs up the valley still full.
